messages:
sara: heads-up — after the role-mapping deploy (yesterday) some viewer users are seeing an Edit button on project settings. repro steps below, this looks like a role assertion issue not a UI bug

sara: repro steps: 1) login as org:user_viewer@acme 2) go to /orgs/acme/projects/alpha/settings 3) Edit button visible and clickable 4) API call to /api/projects/alpha returns can_edit: true in the response

sara: example api response snippet:```json
{
  "user": "user_viewer@acme",
  "role": "editor", 
  "can_edit": true
}
```

dinesh: thanks — can you paste the assertion log from the auth service? need to see where role was derived (mapping table vs jwt claim)

sara: auth logs attached: ```INFO role-assertion request_id=req_0a1b mapping_id=mm-3 user=user_viewer@acme derived_role=editor source=role-mapper-v2``` looks like role-mapper-v2 returned editor for that principal

alex: fyi we pushed a role merge script last night that consolidated workspace_viewer -> viewer -> viewer (normalized), there was a fallback path that defaults to editor when a mapping rule is missing. might be that some orgs hit the fallback

maria: checked audit logs for the requests and I don't see role_assertion entries for those request_ids. we have request_id but the audit pipeline dropped some events during the mapper rollout window.

incident-bot: Created INC-2026-042: RBAC role-assertion regression affecting UI gating. Priority: P3. Pager oncall: @oncall

carol: quick triage: front-end gating is based on can_edit flag from API, but server should still enforce perms. if mapper can return 'editor' incorrectly we need a server-side sanity check: allowed roles set = [viewer, editor, admin, billing]. anything else => deny edit. can we push a short-term validator to auth-service?

dinesh: agree. temporary mitigation: 1) patch auth-service to post-validate mapping against org-specific role matrix (deny on unexpected promotion) 2) add defensive check in projects API to ignore can_edit if role not in allowed set 3) revert fallback defaulting to editor in role-mapper-v2 until we fix mapping DB

alex: also possible contributor: KMS rotation yesterday changed token kid values. if we re-issued JWTs but didn't update our jwk fetch logic, some tokens might be parsed with stale claim mappings. check jwt header kid vs current keys. command: ```jwt decode --no-verify <token> | jq .header```

maria: I'm not seeing the role_assertion audit lines because the mapper flush job to the kafka topic failed (timeout to kafka-cluster-2). I restarted the connector and it's replaying. will attach missing events to the incident thread once available.

sara: for immediate verification I created test user with same groups; role-mapper returns viewer for 3/4 requests and editor for 1/4. seems nondeterministic under certain org configs (probably the merged-rule key collision).

carol: roadmap next steps: - hotfix auth-service validator (short term) - revert role-mapper fallback and redeploy - run the mapping sanity check across all orgs (script attached) - verify audit replay captures all role_assertion events - communicate to impacted customers if any editing actions were performed by viewers

oncall: marking this as Sev3 for now. I'll own the rollback window if we need it. adding :eyes:

dinesh: I'll open a PR for the auth-service validator and link it to INC-2026-042. PR will include unit tests for the mapping edgecases.

sara: putting together a short postmortem template and list of affected orgs once audit replay finishes. tagging @maria to attach logs when ready. thanks all.
